name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native workflow that reserves high-value judgment for Sol and balances native Luna/Terra/Sol subagents by role, latency, and risk.

interface.shortDescription: Sol owns critical judgment; native V2 balances Luna, Terra, and Sol by role.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor routes every request by default. Sol primary keeps intent, architecture/contracts, authorization, risk, option selection, integration, and acceptance; native V2 uses Luna High for bounded exploration and testing, Terra High for deep reconnaissance and normal implementation, Luna High for tightly constrained mechanical worker fast-paths, and Sol Medium/High for independent review based on critical risk. Non-trivial unknown paths still start cited repository reconnaissance before broad primary search. Browser/runtime QA honors an exact user-selected tool without fallback; default or generic QA probes capabilities and uses the desktop Chrome extension, registered headless chrome-devtools-mcp, then an already-installed runnable Playwright CLI as last fallback, or blocks with exact missing capabilities. App-task Luna and legacy Terra/Sol companion roles remain explicit compatibility options.
defaultPrompt: Route through Sol Advisor; keep high-value judgment in Sol and use the balanced native Luna/Terra/Sol model matrix.
Use app-task Luna or legacy Terra/Sol companion roles only when I explicitly authorize compatibility.
